Deployed and reported back to Pablo. Summary of what shipped in this round (PR #104, merged into main):

1. **Position drift fixed** — found and fixed two separate causes: repositioning on every new TTS item, and a screen-inset clamp firing on native resize-drag release. Windowed mode now only positions the window once on first show and never touches it again.
2. **Dock icon fixed** — root cause was a static `LSUIElement=true` in the app's Info.plist pinning it as background regardless of runtime activation-policy calls, plus a policy-check-before-window-visible ordering bug. Both fixed; confirmed via `lsappinfo` showing `ApplicationType=Foreground` while the windowed player is open.
3. **History list restyled** — replaced the glass/blue HUD card look with a plain native SwiftUI `List`, and stopped forcing dark mode in windowed mode so it follows system appearance.
4. **Menu bar simplified** — removed the popover's queue/history list; both click types now open one small settings dropdown (Show/Hide Player, Windowed/HUD toggle, Pause All).
5. Had an Engineer subagent audit the whole controller for other HUD-vs-windowed gating gaps — it found and fixed the resize-clamp bug (#1 above) and consolidated the scattered mode checks into one documented `usesFloatingHUD` property.

Deployed to Pablo's live app; waiting on his hands-on test.
